selected.title: FCA calls for disclaimers on AI financial advice
selected.summary: The UK's financial services watchdog is calling on AI providers to issue disclaimers for services that provide financial advice to consumers via agentic AI.
selected.why: FCA initiates new regulatory expectations regarding disclaimers on consumer AI financial advice.

reason: FCA's AI financial advice disclaimer call raises genuine debate: whether disclosure requirements solve the problem or create false confidence in inadequate regulation
angle: Mandating disclaimers on AI financial advice may obscure the need for substantive competence standards and create liability theater rather than investor protection
